instrument: MMSC, LLC v. Washington County (Ark. Sup. Ct., March 2026)
summary: Arkansas Supreme Court held that deciding an individual conditional-use application by applying existing standards to facts is a quasi-judicial act, not a legislative one, with procedural consequences for county data center permitting.
